notes.title: Road Food Simulator Full Version Features
notes.notes:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207670/Road_Food_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink]
Hello Pizza Chefs


Road Food Simulator Full Version Out Now !



Here are some brand new features:


Play Co-Op with all game features!
The best pizza is made with teamwork.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615340/75083605dc7118119ec4a8d236230095169638b0.jpg"]


New pizza toppings and drinks
Delicious Sausages, Mushrooms and Bacon. Added to Road Food Simulator to make amazing pizzas.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615340/11a9573d5343088d945585c9218f43c103c994bd.jpg"]


New pizza recipes
You can cook many types of pizza for your customers.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615340/15ba07709c22d0422e52cca622b25c35ed554160.jpg"]


Staff for your restaurant


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615340/b511f16bde11cc93fb6d37dba28b0221bfd86338.jpg"]


Keep your restaurant clean
In the full version you must keep your restaurant clean



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615340/cc48f2ee2e7311825b597f1304ed1f0585fa1035.jpg"]


...and unexpected guests!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45615340/87f54b53a6e49a9fc0b885a44c6f704c6f1c206a.jpg"]




Check out Road Food Simulator Full version for much more!


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207670/Road_Food_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Road Food Simulator Prologue Hotfix 5
notes.notes:
Road Food Simulator Prologue Hotfix 5

* Customer visit speeds for Single Player and Multiplayer games have been made different.

Don't forget to add it to your wishlist for Road Food Simulator Full version!

In the full version:

* You will be able to make 15 different great pizzas with Mushrooms, Sausages, Bacon and many other pizza toppings.

* You will be able to offer new beverages to your customers and make profit.

* You will be able to expand your pizza empire by hiring employees such as Waiters, Waitresses, Cashiers.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207670/Road_Food_Simulator
